an3.183-352:1.1: “Bhikkhus, for direct knowledge of lust, three things are to be developed.
an3.183-352:1.3: Emptiness concentration, markless concentration, and wishless concentration.
an3.183-352:1.4: For direct knowledge of lust, these three things are to be developed.”
an3.183-352:2.1: “Bhikkhus, for full understanding of lust … for the utter destruction … for the abandoning … for the destruction … for the vanishing … for the fading away … for the cessation … for the giving up … For the relinquishment of lust, these three things are to be developed. “Bhikkhus, for direct knowledge … for full understanding …
an3.183-352:3.26: three things are to be developed. What three? Emptiness concentration, markless concentration, and wishless concentration. For the relinquishment of heedlessness, these three things are to be developed.”
an3.183-352:4.1: This is what the Blessed One said.
an3.183-352:4.2: Elated, those bhikkhus delighted in the Blessed One’s statement.
an3.183-352:8.6: The Book of the Threes is finished.
